final: WITH race_entries AS (SELECT raceId, COUNT(*) AS entry_count, COALESCE(SUM(points), 0) AS total_constructor_points FROM constructorResults GROUP BY raceId), race_average AS (SELECT AVG(entry_count) AS average_entries FROM race_entries) SELECT re.raceId, c.country, re.total_constructor_points, re.entry_count, re.entry_count - ra.average_entries AS difference_from_average FROM race_entries AS re JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = re.raceId JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId CROSS JOIN race_average AS ra WHERE re.entry_count > ra.average_entries ORDER BY difference_from_average DESC, re.raceId LIMIT 10
